runtimeAdapter.flatPointScaleReason: Source Mobile flat stats and native P2 stats use incompatible numeric scales; raw Wiki values remain visible and are not overwritten.
runtimeAdapter.linkedSealActivation: active only while its exact source formation is selected; source unlock condition is ownership
runtimeAdapter.activationDistribution: SIMULATED: distribute the published maxTotal evenly across 25 ranks; split total evenly across flat attributes, with remainder assigned in source order.
runtimeAdapter.activationCost: SIMULATED: Chiến Tích only; formula is implemented in runtime and shown in UI.
runtimeAdapter.discount: UNRESOLVED: the official page labels seal quotes as base prices but publishes no seal-specific discount formula; equipment discounts are explicitly not reused.
runtimeAdapter.currencyAcquisition: SIMULATED: earned only through successful native first clears/repeats and map completions; no free/debug grants.
runtimeAdapter.attributeSemantics: DERIVED_FROM_SOURCE: flat stat abbreviations map to their corresponding native P2 combat axes; Dẫn binh maps to troop capacity, Hồi phục to healing output.
runtimeAdapter.legacyMigration: SIMULATED: stable v1 project seal aliases map to Mobile IDs; collisions merge by max and are recorded in a migration ledger.
